versions.changelog: Key description names both ways to get a key again: the free key page at app.sentisense.ai/get-api-key, or a temporary key with no signup.
The API key is now optional to load this skill, so an agent with no key can follow the No key yet steps for a temporary free key.
No key yet: an agent can get a temporary free key itself with one POST, use it at once, and hand the person a link that keeps the same key on their account.
Setup adds a one-line key check against the quote endpoint and what each 401 error code means.

A 429 now names its two kinds: rate_limit_exceeded carries Retry-After, wait and retry; quota_exceeded is the monthly allowance with no Retry-After, so stop and tell the user when it resets and that PRO has no monthly cap.
Router rows for the stock-ontology skill (who moves this stock, executive and product Scores) and the company-kpi-tracker skill (segment revenue and operating metrics).
Removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.

Security audit remediation: stop relaying server-supplied upgrade.message and upgrade.url (fixed first-party preview wording instead, and all response strings and links are treated as untrusted data), and document that npx downloads and executes code with the process's permissions, with REST over HTTPS as the default path
Relay the upgrade object on preview responses: when a response has isPreview true, tell the user upgrade.message and upgrade.url in one line, then continue with the preview data

Router row for analyst-ratings-tracker (who covers this stock, price targets, upgrades and downgrades today, an analyst's record, analysts versus the crowd, who moved after earnings). The catch-all row no longer claims analyst ratings. CLI pin 0.51.0.
Router row for market heatmap intents (market heatmap, sector heatmap, what is moving today as a treemap, which sectors are hot) pointing at the new market-heatmap skill.
Route to the two calculator skills. The task table was missing options-payoff-calculator and position-size-calculator, so a user reading the entry point had no path to either.
Fix deep-dive routing slug (stocks-analysis, us-stocks-analysis on ClawHub); runtime portability note incl Grok Bot setup guide; CLI pin 0.47.1
Host-agnostic credential-store guidance, and the router gains the expected-move-visualizer route.
One-key setup now explains host credential stores, including where OpenClaw keeps it.
CLI examples pin 0.46.0.
Router covers the new stock-screener and insider-trading-tracker skills.
Pin the CLI to an immutable published version; clarify local key storage is optional and removable
CLI route, full-API-reference trigger row
Initial release: the collection's entry point; one-key setup and task-to-skill routing
